title: Editorial review of a setup guide in American English
prompt: Revise this draft into a short setup guide for an operator. Draft: This guide will walk you through the essential workflow. The local service must already be running. Run `coacus-demo check --read-only --port 8080`. The tool prints `READY` when the check succeeds. Reference: [options](./options.md). Write the deliverable in American English. Return only the requested prose. Do not change files.
rubric: Make the running service prerequisite clear before the exact command. Preserve the success message and link destination.
The prose reads naturally in American English and makes the next step or finding easy to locate.
acceptance: All factual and language rubric items hold. Literal checks cover selected source details.
